title: New Rabbit Owner Checklist
description: This checklist is a general guide and does not replace advice from a rabbit-savvy vet. If your rabbit stops eating, stops pooing, seems in pain or is…
body:
<div class="wp-block-group alignfull">
<!--
RabbitCare.co.uk tool page block
Page: New Rabbit Owner Checklist
Suggested URL: /new-rabbit-owner-checklist/

How to use in WordPress:
1) Create/edit the "New Rabbit Owner Checklist" page.
2) Add a "Custom HTML" block.
3) Replace the old page content with everything below.

SEO plugin settings:
SEO title: New Rabbit Owner Checklist | First-Time Rabbit Care Guide
Meta description: Use our new rabbit owner checklist to prepare your rabbit’s housing, hay, bedding, toys, safe foods, cleaning routine and health checks.
Focus keyphrase: new rabbit owner checklist
URL slug: new-rabbit-owner-checklist
-->

<section class="rcown-page alignfull" id="new-rabbit-owner-checklist">
  <style>
    :root {
      --rc-cream: #fff9ef;
      --rc-cream-2: #f6ead8;
      --rc-sage: #7f9b72;
      --rc-sage-dark: #4e6b45;
      --rc-moss: #2f4a2e;
      --rc-brown: #8a6246;
      --rc-gold: #d7a64b;
      --rc-charcoal: #2d2d2b;
      --rc-muted: #6f6a61;
      --rc-white: #ffffff;
      --rc-danger: #9b3b2f;
      --rc-danger-soft: #fff0eb;
      --rc-warn: #9a6a1c;
      --rc-warn-soft: #fff5df;
      --rc-safe: #4e6b45;
      --rc-safe-soft: #eff8ed;
      --rc-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.16);
      --rc-radius-xl: 34px;
      --rc-max: 1180px;
      --rc-font-heading: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      --rc-font-body: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    .rcown-page,
    .rcown-page * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    body,
    .wp-site-blocks,
    .entry-content,
    .wp-block-post-content,
    main { background: #fef4f0 !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks,
    body .entry-content,
    body .wp-block-post-content,
    body main,
    body article,
    body .wp-block-group,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      gap: 0 !important;
      row-gap: 0 !important;
    }

    body .entry-header,
    body .page-header,
    body .wp-block-post-title,
    body h1.wp-block-post-title,
    body .wp-block-post-featured-image { display: none !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks > * + *,
    body .entry-content > * + *,
    body .wp-block-post-content > * + * { margin-block-start: 0 !important; }

    body .wp-block-html,
    body .entry-content > .wp-block-html,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      margin-bottom: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      padding-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .rcown-page {
      position: relative;
      left: calc(50% + 20px);
      width: calc(100vw + 40px);
      max-width: none;
      margin: -120px 0 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.18), transparent 32rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rc-cream) 0%, #fffdf8 46%, #fef4f0 100%);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      line-height: 1.68;
    }

    .rcown-page a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }

    .rcown-page a:focus-visible,
    .rcown-page button:focus-visible,
    .rcown-page input:focus-visible,
    .rcown-page select:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.9);
      outline-offset: 4px;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    .rcown-wrap { width: min(var(--rc-max), calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }
    .rcown-narrow { width: min(920px, calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }

    .rcown-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .rcown-pill::before { content: "✦"; color: var(--rc-gold); }

    .rcown-btns {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      align-items: center;
      margin-top: 30px;
    }

    .rcown-btn,
    .rcown-generate-button,
    .rcown-print-button {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 52px;
      padding: 14px 22px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 900;
      border: 0;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcown-btn:hover,
    .rcown-generate-button:hover,
    .rcown-print-button:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); }

    .rcown-btn-primary,
    .rcown-generate-button {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rc-sage-dark), var(--rc-sage));
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(79, 112, 70, 0.26);
    }

    .rcown-btn-secondary,
    .rcown-print-button {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.16);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcown-hero {
      padding: 0 0 42px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.18), transparent 28rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #fff9ef 0%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0) 100%);
    }

    .rcown-hero-image-wrap { width: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 0; background: #fff9ef; overflow: hidden; }
    .rcown-hero-cover { position: relative; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; }

    .rcown-hero-cover::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.70), rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.30) 48%, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.06)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), transparent 45%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.12));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcown-hero-image {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center;
      background: #fff;
      animation: rcownFadeIn 0.9s ease both;
    }

    .rcown-hero-title-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      left: max(24px, calc((100vw - var(--rc-max)) / 2));
      bottom: clamp(28px, 8vw, 96px);
      max-width: 850px;
      padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 38px);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .rcown-hero-title-overlay .rcown-pill { color: #ffffff; text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); }

    .rcown-hero-title-overlay h1 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem);
      line-height: 0.88;
      letter-spacing: -0.065em;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-wrap: balance;
      text-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
    }

    .rcown-hero-title-overlay p {
      max-width: 660px;
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36);
    }

    .rcown-hero-content {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr;
      gap: 34px;
      align-items: center;
      padding-top: 44px;
    }

    .rcown-breadcrumb {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rcown-breadcrumb a { color: var(--rc-sage-dark); }

    .rcown-intro-heading {
      margin: 12px 0 16px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.4rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcown-hero-subtitle {
      max-width: 740px;
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 2vw, 1.28rem);
    }

    .rcown-hero-card,
    .rcown-panel,
    .rcown-side-card,
    .rcown-tool,
    .rcown-result,
    .rcown-item-card,
    .rcown-tip,
    .rcown-related-card {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcown-hero-card {
      padding: 28px;
      border-radius: 38px;
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rcown-hero-card h2 { margin: 0 0 14px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.35rem; line-height: 1.18; }
    .rcown-hero-card ul { display: grid; gap: 12px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }

    .rcown-hero-card li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: start;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rcown-hero-card li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rcown-quickbar { position: relative; z-index: 4; margin-top: 26px; }

    .rcown-quickbar-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rcown-quick {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 62px 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      min-height: 96px;
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #fff8eb);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcown-quick:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(83, 61, 42, 0.14); }
    .rcown-quick-icon { width: 62px; height: 62px; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 2.35rem; line-height: 1; }
    .rcown-quick strong { display: block; color: var(--rc-moss); line-height: 1.15; font-size: 1.02rem; }
    .rcown-quick span span { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.35; }

    .rcown-section { width: 100%; padding: 72px 0; position: relative; }
    .rcown-section-header { max-width: 820px; margin: 0 auto 32px; text-align: center; }

    .rcown-section h2,
    .rcown-final h2 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.6rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcown-section-header p {
      margin: 0 auto;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      max-width: 700px;
    }

    .rcown-article-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .rcown-content { display: grid; gap: 24px; }

    .rcown-panel {
      position: relative;
      padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 38px);
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcown-panel::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 190px;
      height: 190px;
      right: -82px;
      top: -92px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.10);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcown-panel > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .rcown-panel h2 { margin-top: 0; }
    .rcown-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 10px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.45rem; line-height: 1.2; }
    .rcown-panel p { margin: 0 0 16px; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 1.03rem; }
    .rcown-panel p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

    .rcown-sidebar { position: sticky; top: 22px; display: grid; gap: 18px; }
    .rcown-side-card { padding: 22px; border-radius: 28px; }
    .rcown-side-card h2 { margin: 0 0 14px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.18rem; line-height: 1.2; }
    .rcown-side-card ul { display: grid; gap: 10px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }

    .rcown-side-card a {
      display: block;
      padding: 11px 12px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 850;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
    }

    .rcown-side-card a:hover { transform: translateX(4px); background: #fff4d8; }

    .rcown-note {
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border-left: 6px solid var(--rc-gold);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rcown-note strong { color: var(--rc-moss); }

    /* Checklist generator */
    .rcown-tool-section {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0), rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.09), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rcown-tool {
      padding: clamp(18px, 3vw, 30px);
      border-radius: 42px;
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr;
      gap: 18px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .rcown-form {
      display: grid;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: clamp(18px, 3vw, 26px);
      border-radius: 30px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #fff8eb);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
    }

    .rcown-field {
      display: grid;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .rcown-field label {
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-weight: 950;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rcown-field small {
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .rcown-field select {
      width: 100%;
      min-height: 52px;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.16);
      background: #ffffff;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      font: inherit;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rcown-check-group {
      display: grid;
      gap: 10px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      border: 0;
    }

    .rcown-check-group legend {
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-weight: 950;
      font-size: 1.02rem;
    }

    .rcown-check {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 30px 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: center;
      min-height: 52px;
      padding: 12px 13px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      background: #ffffff;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
    }

    .rcown-check:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.28); }
    .rcown-check input { width: 20px; height: 20px; accent-color: var(--rc-sage-dark); }
    .rcown-check span { color: var(--rc-muted); font-weight: 850; }
    .rcown-check:has(input:checked) { background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14); border-color: rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.42); }

    .rcown-result {
      display: grid;
      gap: 18px;
      padding: clamp(22px, 4vw, 34px);
      border-radius: 34px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.2), transparent 18rem),
        #ffffff;
    }

    .rcown-result-top {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .rcown-status {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 44px;
      padding: 10px 15px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--rc-safe-soft);
      color: var(--rc-safe);
      font-weight: 950;
    }

    .rcown-status.warn { background: var(--rc-warn-soft); color: var(--rc-warn); }

    .rcown-result h3 {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 2.65rem);
      line-height: 1.05;
      letter-spacing: -0.045em;
    }

    .rcown-result p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 720;
    }

    .rcown-list-block {
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
    }

    .rcown-list-block h4 {
      margin: 0 0 12px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.12rem;
    }

    .rcown-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 9px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcown-list li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr;
      gap: 9px;
      align-items: start;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 760;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .rcown-list li::before {
      content: "□";
      display: block;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 950;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .rcown-mini-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .rcown-mini {
      padding: 15px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
    }

    .rcown-mini strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      margin-bottom: 5px;
    }

    .rcown-mini span {
      display: block;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 850;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .rcown-item-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rcown-item-card,
    .rcown-tip {
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcown-item-card:hover,
    .rcown-tip:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 24px 58px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15); }

    .rcown-item-card b,
    .rcown-tip b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 54px;
      height: 54px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.4rem;
    }

    .rcown-item-card h3,
    .rcown-tip h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.16rem; }

    .rcown-item-card p,
    .rcown-tip p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rcown-warning {
      padding: 68px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 240, 235, 0.56), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rcown-warning-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: clamp(24px, 5vw, 44px);
      border-radius: 42px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(155, 59, 47, 0.16);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
    }

    .rcown-warning-card h2 { color: var(--rc-danger); }
    .rcown-warning-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 1.06rem; }

    .rcown-warning-list {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcown-warning-list li {
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: var(--rc-danger-soft);
      color: #4a2823;
      font-weight: 850;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .rcown-final { padding: 70px 0 42px; background: #fef4f0; }

    .rcown-final-box {
      padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 52px);
      border-radius: 46px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(28, 48, 27, 0.92), rgba(58, 84, 49, 0.86)),
        url("https://rabbitcare.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Rabbitcare-learn-more.png");
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcown-final-box .rcown-pill,
    .rcown-final-box h2,
    .rcown-final-box p {
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rcown-final-box p { max-width: 780px; margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 1.08rem; }

    .rcown-final-box .rcown-btn-secondary {
      background: #ffffff;
      color: #2f4a2e;
      border: 2px solid #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
      text-shadow: none;
    }

    .rcown-related {
      padding: 74px 0;
      background: #fff9ef;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      transform: none !important;
      animation: none !important;
    }

    .rcown-related,

            <p>Check hay eating and droppings every day. Changes can be important early warning signs.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcown-tip">
            <b>🧹</b>
            <h3>Build a routine</h3>
            <p>Daily feeding, cleaning and health checks make it easier to spot changes quickly.</p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rcown-section rcown-reveal" id="faq">
      <div class="rcown-narrow">
        <div class="rcown-panel">
          <span class="rcown-pill">FAQs</span>
          <h2>New rabbit owner questions</h2>

          <div class="rcown-faq-list">
            <details class="rcown-faq-item" open>
              <summary>What should I buy before getting a rabbit?</summary>
              <p>
                Prepare roomy housing, hay, water bowls, suitable bedding or litter, a litter tray, hiding places, chew toys, food bowls, cleaning supplies and a secure carrier.
              </p>
            </details>

            <details class="rcown-faq-item">
              <summary>Should I get one rabbit or two?</summary>
              <p>
                Rabbits are social animals and many do best with a suitable bonded companion. Bonding should be done carefully and safely, especially with rescue rabbits or rabbits that have not met before.
              </p>
            </details>

            <details class="rcown-faq-item">
              <summary>What is the most important daily rabbit care task?</summary>
              <p>
                Check that your rabbit is eating hay, drinking, passing normal droppings and behaving normally. These daily checks can help you spot health problems quickly.
              </p>
            </details>

            <details class="rcown-faq-item">
              <summary>When should a new rabbit owner call a vet?</summary>
              <p>
                Call urgently if your rabbit stops eating, stops pooing, seems bloated, has breathing problems, has flystrike signs, collapses, shows head tilt or suddenly seems very unwell.
              </p>
            </details>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rcown-final rcown-reveal">
      <div class="rcown-wrap rcown-final-box">
        <span class="rcown-pill">Final thoughts</span>
        <h2>A prepared home makes rabbit care calmer</h2>
        <p>
          New rabbit owners do not need to know everything on day one, but the essentials matter: space, hay, water, safe flooring, hiding places, enrichment, routine and knowing when to call a vet.
        </p>
        <p>
          Use the checklist as a starting point, then keep learning from your rabbit’s behaviour and your vet’s advice.
        </p>

        <div class="rcown-btns">
          <a class="rcown-btn rcown-btn-secondary" href="#checklist-generator">Build another checklist</a>
          <a class="rcown-btn rcown-btn-primary" href="/learn-more">Browse rabbit care guides</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rcown-related" aria-label="Related rabbit care guides">
      <div class="rcown-wrap">
        <div class="rcown-section-header">
          <span class="rcown-pill">Keep reading</span>
          <h2>Related rabbit care guides</h2>
          <p>Useful guides for new rabbit owners, including housing, food, health and enrichment.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="rcown-related-grid">
          <a class="rcown-related-card" href="/rabbit-housing-size-calculator">
            <img src="https://rabbitcare.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Rabbitcare-cage-2.png" alt="Rabbit housing size calculator" loading="lazy" decoding="async">
            <span><h3>Housing size calculator</h3><p>Check whether your setup gives enough usable space.</p></span>
          </a>

          <a class="rcown-related-card" href="/can-rabbits-eat-this">
            <img src="https://rabbitcare.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Rabbitcare-carrots-2.png" alt="Rabbit food checker" loading="lazy" decoding="async">
            <span><h3>Can rabbits eat this?</h3><p>Search common foods before offering them to your rabbit.</p></span>

            <img src="https://rabbitcare.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/ChatGPT-Image-Mar-8-2026-10_32_22-AM-1.png" alt="Rabbit symptom checker" loading="lazy" decoding="async">

    <section class="rcown-disclaimer" aria-label="RabbitCare disclaimer">
      <div class="rcown-wrap">
        <p>
          <strong>RabbitCare.co.uk provides general rabbit care information for UK owners.</strong>
          This checklist is a general guide and does not replace advice from a rabbit-savvy vet. If your rabbit stops eating, stops pooing, seems in pain or is suddenly unwell, contact a vet urgently.
        </p>
      </div>

  </main>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const form = document.getElementById("rcownForm");
      const status = document.getElementById("rcownStatus");
      const profile = document.getElementById("rcownProfile");
      const title = document.getElementById("rcownTitle");
      const summary = document.getElementById("rcownSummary");
      const dailyFocus = document.getElementById("rcownDailyFocus");
      const setupFocus = document.getElementById("rcownSetupFocus");
      const healthFocus = document.getElementById("rcownHealthFocus");
      const shopping = document.getElementById("rcownShopping");
      const daily = document.getElementById("rcownDaily");
      const weekly = document.getElementById("rcownWeekly");
      const reminders = document.getElementById("rcownReminders");
      const printButton = document.getElementById("rcownPrint");

      if (!form) return;

      function checkedIncludes() {
        return Array.from(form.querySelectorAll('input[name="include"]:checked')).map(function (input) {
          return input.value;
        });
      }

      function addUnique(list, items) {
        items.forEach(function (item) {
          if (list.indexOf(item) === -1) list.push(item);
        });
      }

      function renderList(element, items) {
        element.innerHTML = items.map(function (item) {
          return "<li>" + item + "</li>";
        }).join("");
      }

      function labelFor(selectId) {
        const select = document.getElementById(selectId);
        return select.options[select.selectedIndex].text;
      }

      function generate(event) {
        if (event) event.preventDefault();

        const setup = document.getElementById("rcownSetup").value;
        const rabbits = document.getElementById("rcownRabbits").value;
        const stage = document.getElementById("rcownStage").value;
        const includes = checkedIncludes();

        const shoppingItems = [];
        const dailyItems = [];
        const weeklyItems = [];
        const reminderItems = [];

        addUnique(shoppingItems, [
          "Secure carrier for vet trips and travel.",
          "Contact details for a rabbit-savvy vet and emergency vet service."
        ]);

        if (includes.indexOf("housing") !== -1) {
          addUnique(shoppingItems, [
            "Roomy enclosure, pen, room setup or secure outdoor housing with enough space to hop and stretch.",
            "Non-slip flooring or mats to protect feet and give grip.",
            "At least one hideout per rabbit, plus tunnels or sheltered resting places."
          ]);

          addUnique(weeklyItems, [
            "Check housing for loose panels, sharp edges, gaps, chewing damage or unsafe flooring.",
            "Refresh layout if needed so food, litter, sleeping and play areas stay clean and useful."
          ]);

          if (setup === "outdoor") {
            addUnique(shoppingItems, [
              "Predator-resistant run or enclosure with secure locks and strong mesh.",
              "Weather protection, shade, waterproof shelter and insulation for seasonal changes."
            ]);
            addUnique(dailyItems, [
              "Check outdoor locks, mesh, flooring, shade, shelter and water temperature."
            ]);
            setupFocus.textContent = "Secure outdoor shelter with permanent run access and predator protection";
          } else if (setup === "free-roam") {
            addUnique(shoppingItems, [
              "Cable protectors, barriers and rabbit-proofing supplies for unsafe areas.",
              "Washable rugs or mats for grip on slippery floors."
            ]);
            addUnique(dailyItems, [
              "Check wires, furniture gaps, houseplants and unsafe items are still protected."
            ]);
            setupFocus.textContent = "Rabbit-proofed free-roam room with a safe base area";
          } else if (setup === "mixed") {
            addUnique(shoppingItems, [
              "Safe transport carrier or routine for moving between areas.",
              "Weather-aware outdoor equipment and indoor resting space."
            ]);
            addUnique(dailyItems, [
              "Check both indoor and outdoor spaces before your rabbits move between them."
            ]);
            setupFocus.textContent = "Safe indoor base plus secure outdoor exercise routine";
          } else {
            setupFocus.textContent = "Roomy indoor pen or rabbit-proofed room";
          }
        }

        if (includes.indexOf("diet") !== -1) {
          addUnique(shoppingItems, [
            "Large supply of good-quality feeding hay.",
            "Heavy water bowl or bottle, plus a spare if useful.",
            "Suitable rabbit pellets and safe fresh greens introduced gradually."
          ]);
          addUnique(dailyItems, [
            "Top up unlimited hay and check your rabbit is eating it.",
            "Refresh water and clean bowls or bottles.",
            "Offer suitable fresh foods slowly and remove uneaten wet food."
          ]);
          addUnique(weeklyItems, [
            "Check hay is fresh, dry, fragrant and not dusty or mouldy.",
            "Review treats and fruit so sugary foods stay occasional."
          ]);
        }

        if (includes.indexOf("cleaning") !== -1) {
          addUnique(shoppingItems, [
            "Roomy litter tray and rabbit-safe litter or bedding.",
            "Dustpan, pet-safe cleaning supplies and spare bedding."
          ]);
          addUnique(dailyItems, [
            "Spot-clean litter tray, wet bedding and dirty areas.",
            "Check bottom, feet and fur are clean and dry."
          ]);
          addUnique(weeklyItems, [
            "Deep-clean litter trays and refresh bedding.",
            "Wash bowls, wipe surfaces and tidy hay or forage areas."
          ]);
        }

        if (includes.indexOf("enrichment") !== -1) {
          addUnique(shoppingItems, [
            "Safe chew toys, cardboard boxes, tunnels and forage activities.",
            "Digging box or enrichment tray if suitable for your setup."
          ]);
          addUnique(dailyItems, [
            "Offer safe chewing, foraging or exploring opportunities.",
            "Check toys for damage and remove anything unsafe."
          ]);
          addUnique(weeklyItems, [
            "Rotate toys, tunnels and forage activities to prevent boredom."
          ]);
        }

        if (includes.indexOf("health") !== -1) {
          addUnique(dailyItems, [
            "Check appetite, droppings, posture, energy and breathing.",
            "Look for signs of pain, head tilt, dirty bottom, flystrike risk or sudden behaviour change."
          ]);
          addUnique(weeklyItems, [
            "Do a gentle body check: eyes, nose, teeth area, nails, feet, bottom and coat.",
            "Update your vet contact details and know your nearest emergency option."
          ]);
          addUnique(reminderItems, [
            "Call a rabbit-savvy vet urgently if your rabbit stops eating or stops pooing.",
            "Use the symptom checker if you are unsure how urgent a warning sign is."
          ]);
        }

        if (rabbits === "one") {
          addUnique(reminderItems, [
            "Consider whether your rabbit would benefit from a suitable bonded rabbit companion.",
            "Spend calm time nearby every day so your rabbit can build trust at their own pace."
          ]);
        } else if (rabbits === "pair") {
          addUnique(reminderItems, [
            "Provide enough space, hides and resources so both rabbits can eat and rest comfortably.",
            "Watch for any chasing, guarding or changes in the bond."
          ]);
        } else if (rabbits === "group") {
          addUnique(reminderItems, [
            "Use multiple hay piles, water points and hiding places to reduce competition.",
            "Check each rabbit individually each day, not just the group as a whole."
          ]);
        } else {
          addUnique(reminderItems, [
            "Research safe bonding before introducing rabbits face-to-face.",
            "Do not rush bonding; use neutral space and separate if there is serious fighting."
          ]);
        }

        if (stage === "before") {
          addUnique(reminderItems, [
            "Set everything up before collection day so your rabbit can settle straight into a safe space.",
            "Book or research a rabbit-savvy vet before there is an emergency."
          ]);
          status.textContent = "Preparation checklist";
        } else if (stage === "first-week") {
          addUnique(reminderItems, [
            "Keep the first week calm with minimal handling and a steady routine.",
            "Watch eating and droppings closely while your rabbit settles."
          ]);
          status.textContent = "First-week checklist";
        } else if (stage === "rescue") {
          addUnique(reminderItems, [
            "Ask the rescue what food, litter and routine your rabbit is used to.",
            "Make changes gradually unless a vet advises otherwise."
          ]);
          status.textContent = "Rescue rabbit checklist";
        } else {
          addUnique(reminderItems, [
            "Choose one improvement at a time: space, flooring, enrichment, diet or cleaning routine.",
            "Use your rabbit’s behaviour to spot what needs improving."
          ]);
          status.textContent = "Improvement checklist";
        }

        addUnique(dailyItems, [
          "Spend quiet time observing your rabbit’s normal habits.",
          "Make sure hay and water are available before bedtime."
        ]);

        if (shoppingItems.length === 2) {
          addUnique(shoppingItems, [
            "Hay, water bowl, litter tray, safe bedding, hideouts and chew toys.",
            "Roomy housing with safe flooring and enough space to move."
          ]);
        }

        profile.textContent = labelFor("rcownSetup") + " · " + labelFor("rcownRabbits");
        title.textContent = "Your new rabbit owner checklist";
        summary.textContent = "This checklist is tailored for: " + labelFor("rcownSetup").toLowerCase() + ", " + labelFor("rcownRabbits").toLowerCase() + ", " + labelFor("rcownStage").toLowerCase() + ".";
        dailyFocus.textContent = includes.indexOf("health") !== -1 ? "Hay, water, droppings, appetite and behaviour" : "Food, water, cleanliness and routine";
        healthFocus.textContent = includes.indexOf("health") !== -1 ? "Know urgent warning signs before you need them" : "Save a rabbit-savvy vet contact now";

        renderList(shopping, shoppingItems);
        renderList(daily, dailyItems);
        renderList(weekly, weeklyItems);
        renderList(reminders, reminderItems);
      }

      form.addEventListener("submit", generate);
      form.addEventListener("change", generate);

      if (printButton) {
        printButton.addEventListener("click", function () {
          window.print();
        });
      }

      generate();
    })();
  </script>
</section>
</div>
